weekly_digest.headline: Terminal fleets electrify as automation expands and fuel trials advance
weekly_digest.editorial: This initial monthly batch highlights equipment electrification, automation investment and ship–terminal energy integration. Grid capacity, interoperable control systems and operational ramp-up emerge as shared delivery constraints. No thread history was supplied; only the clearly connected Wilhelmshaven reports are chained. Coverage is selective rather than exhaustive: WorldCargo News blocked access, Marine Civils was unavailable, and many PTI records rely on retrieved cached article text with lower confidence. Coordinates use city-level approximations except headquarters pins for multi-site news; validation follows the skill's documented fields because its referenced schema file was not supplied.

articles.title: Southampton completes £60m quay crane programme
articles.summary: DP World welcomed two further quay cranes at Southampton, completing a £60 million four-crane programme. The delivery expands handling capability for large container ships.
articles.terminal_impact: Benchmark quay equipment renewal against vessel mix.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Santos receives two quay cranes and six electric RTGs
articles.summary: DP World received two quay cranes and six fully electric RTGs at Santos under a BRL1.6 billion expansion. Capacity is targeted at 1.7 million TEUs by end-2026, with another equipment delivery expected in early 2027.
key_points: Two quay cranes and six electric RTGs delivered
articles.terminal_impact: Assess combined power and quay capacity requirements for expansion.
articles.criticality_rationale: The technology delivery forms part of a BRL1.6 billion terminal expansion.

articles.title: EUROGATE orders four automated stacking cranes
articles.summary: EUROGATE ordered four Konecranes automated stacking cranes for Wilhelmshaven, with handover planned for Q2 2028. Integration will use a supplier-agnostic equipment control system; the agreement includes an option for four Hamburg cranes.
articles.terminal_impact: Evaluate multi-vendor ECS integration when automating existing yards.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete contract has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: EUROGATE secures €82m for automation pilot
articles.summary: KfW IPEX-Bank is lending EUROGATE €82 million for its Wilhelmshaven automation pilot. Autonomous trucks, automated stacking cranes and in-house software will be tested before decisions on expansion to Hamburg and other German sites.
key_points: Wider rollout depends on pilot results
articles.terminal_impact: Track integration results before committing to fleet-wide automation.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete contract has direct implications for terminal operations.
articles.chaining_rationale: Financing supports the same Wilhelmshaven automation programme reported with the ASC order.

articles.title: Modern Terminals and CLPe plan electrification roadmap
articles.summary: Modern Terminals and CLPe agreed to study electrification of Hong Kong container operations. Assessments cover shore power, tractor battery swapping, equipment charging and electric barges before a phased investment roadmap.
key_points: Feasibility studies and technical assessments planned
articles.terminal_impact: Include utility partners early in charging and shore-power design.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: Katoen Natie inaugurates two electric mobile harbour cranes
articles.summary: Katoen Natie inaugurated two 150-tonne electric Gottwald ESP.8 cranes at Antwerp on 15 October. They belong to a six-crane programme combining grid supply and batteries, allowing movement between positions without a diesel engine.
key_points: Six-crane fleet includes four ESP.9 units
articles.terminal_impact: Compare battery-supported mobility for multipurpose berth electrification.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: US announces $17m for Colombo port digital systems
articles.summary: The US announced a $17 million grant for Sri Lanka's Maritime Single Window and Port Community System. The proposed support targets documentation and data exchange at Colombo, improving coordination among terminals, Customs and shipping lines.
key_points: Maritime Single Window and PCS targeted
articles.terminal_impact: Map interfaces between terminal systems and national clearance platforms.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: Belfast secures £15m for integrated zero-emission trials
articles.summary: Belfast Harbour will host ZETEC trials under a £15 million investment announced on 15 October. Artemis Technologies leads work connecting electric vessels, charging, autonomous transport and energy systems through secure digital twins.
key_points: Integrated testing in a working port
articles.terminal_impact: Watch whether integrated energy and transport trials remove deployment barriers.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: Dongwon plans KRW200bn automated terminal expansion
articles.summary: Dongwon Global Terminal Busan plans KRW200 billion of automated equipment and operating-system investment by 2028. The agreement covers the West Container Terminal at Busan New Port, expanding its existing automated operations.
articles.terminal_impact: Benchmark expansion of an already automated terminal against greenfield approaches.
articles.criticality_rationale: A KRW200 billion automation expansion is a material competitive investment.

articles.title: Guam restores third crane with conditional certification
articles.summary: Guam returned its third wind-damaged gantry crane to cargo work after a load test. Crane 5 remains unable to travel independently on the rails while motors are replaced, highlighting the need to distinguish lifting certification from full mobility.
key_points: Three cranes damaged in 2 October wind incident
articles.terminal_impact: Review storm securing procedures and recovery acceptance criteria.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: HHLA reports throughput pressure during automation ramp-up
articles.summary: HHLA reported that further automation ramp-up at Hamburg terminals and strike disruption contributed to throughput below expectations. Its revised outlook also reflects other business factors, so an isolated financial cost of automation cannot be inferred.
key_points: Automation ramp-up cited among several causes
articles.terminal_impact: Build ramp-up buffers and fallback operating modes into automation plans.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete operational disruption has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Jeddah deploys 17 automated electric RTGs
articles.summary: DP World deployed 17 automated electric RTGs at Jeddah's South Container Terminal following a $56 million investment. Electric and automated units now account for 50 of its 77 RTGs, combining remote operation with lower reported emissions.
key_points: About 64% lower annual CO2 per crane expected
articles.terminal_impact: Benchmark remote-operation staffing and electrical demand at fleet scale.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: IMO assesses maritime single-window needs in Dakar
articles.summary: IMO assessed requirements for a maritime single window at Dakar during 5–9 October. Consultations covered public agencies, shipping representatives and terminal operators to identify process and institutional changes needed for implementation.
articles.terminal_impact: Document clearance workflows before selecting a digital platform.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: DP World deploys 55 electric yard tractors in Busan
articles.summary: DP World deployed 55 electric yard tractors in Busan, replacing LNG vehicles. The new units make up about 36% of the 154-vehicle fleet; the operator expects around 70% lower CO2 emissions per replacement vehicle.
key_points: Reported emissions reduction is an expectation
articles.terminal_impact: Compare charging duty cycles and emissions assumptions with LNG fleets.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Kongsberg wins 10-year Port Hedland vessel traffic contract
articles.summary: Kongsberg secured a 10-year vessel traffic service contract at Port Hedland. A system-as-a-service arrangement includes radar, optical sensors, AIS and VHF, plus maintenance of the new system and the existing Dampier installation.
key_points: Port Hedland and Dampier support included
articles.terminal_impact: Assess lifecycle service commitments when replacing vessel traffic systems.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete contract has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Singapore completes 5,000-tonne ethanol bunkering during cargo work
articles.summary: PSA hosted Singapore's first ethanol bunkering at Pasir Panjang alongside container operations. Maersk Halifax received about 5,000 tonnes of certified bioethanol using mass-flow metering, testing procedures for integrating the fuel into a working terminal.
key_points: Methanol reference TR 129 being assessed for ethanol
articles.terminal_impact: Review SIMOPS risk assessments before adding ethanol bunkering.
stakeholders: Maritime and Port Authority of Singapore
articles.criticality_rationale: A reported record-scale ethanol transfer demonstrated bunkering during live cargo handling.

articles.title: Valencia tenders €18.7m substation for port electrification
articles.summary: Valencia launched an €18.7 million tender for its ST2 electrical substation. The 20-month project will support terminal loads and shore power, with independent incoming connections intended to improve supply resilience.
key_points: Shared capacity stated as 40–90 MW depending on connection
articles.terminal_impact: Plan redundancy alongside new capacity for cranes, reefers and shore power.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: Latakia receives six hybrid electric RTGs
articles.summary: Latakia International Container Terminal received six hybrid electric RTGs on 22 October under a project with CMA CGM. The equipment is intended to improve stacking density, handling efficiency and vessel service.
articles.terminal_impact: Check operating data before relying on projected productivity improvements.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Szczecin university commissions second port training VR simulator
articles.summary: Flint Systems commissioned a second Perun Experience VR simulator at the Maritime University of Szczecin. It supports STS, RTG and mobile harbour crane training without occupying operational equipment.
key_points: Installation completed in second half of October
articles.terminal_impact: Assess VR for repeatable training before trainees access live machinery.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Oakland prepares charging infrastructure for Matson Terminal
articles.summary: Oakland marked the start of a Matson Terminal infrastructure project to enable a fully zero-emission cargo-handling fleet. Charging and electrical upgrades are expected to finish in 2028, supported by $119 million in state funding.
articles.terminal_impact: Sequence charging infrastructure ahead of full fleet replacement.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Cisco and PSA plan AI incident-management pilot at Tuas
articles.summary: Cisco and PSA are developing a proof of concept for AI observability and incident management at Tuas Port. It will combine application, infrastructure and network data to diagnose failures and support response; operational benefits remain to be demonstrated.
articles.terminal_impact: Test dependency visibility and incident recovery before scaling automation.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: Vietnam electric barge integrates Gemalink charging and solar power
articles.summary: CMA CGM, Nike and Gemadept launched an electric barge linking Ho Chi Minh City and Gemalink. CATL batteries recharge in about four hours using renewable electricity, supported by terminal charging and solar infrastructure.
articles.terminal_impact: Evaluate barge charging against berth windows and renewable supply.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Virginia orders 10 electric Kalmar straddle carriers
articles.summary: The Port of Virginia ordered 10 electric Kalmar straddle carriers for Norfolk International Terminals, due in Q3 2027. Lithium-ion batteries are specified for up to 600 minutes of operation, with collision warnings included.
articles.terminal_impact: Validate advertised runtime against actual lifting and travel cycles.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete contract has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: HYPOBATT completes 1 MW marine charging trials
articles.summary: HYPOBATT completed a 1 MW marine charging pilot at the Port of Frisia with automatic and manual connections. The scalable design supports up to 2.25 MW and contributes practical input to developing DC ship-to-shore connection standards.
articles.terminal_impact: Use demonstrated connection times when assessing electric vessel turnaround.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: StormGeo acquires Portchain to connect voyages and berth plans
articles.summary: StormGeo completed its Portchain acquisition on 30 October. The companies plan to connect voyage optimisation with berth, crane and workforce planning; Portchain initially remains independent. This multi-site story is mapped to StormGeo's headquarters.
key_points: Integration planned for a later stage
articles.terminal_impact: Review roadmap and data interfaces for just-in-time vessel arrivals.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Port Hedland completes first Australian green ammonia bunkering
articles.summary: Port Hedland completed Australia's first green ammonia bunkering trial for Mineral Europa on 2 November. Pilbara Ports, Fortescue and CMB.TECH used a two-hour transfer supported by dispersion modelling, compatibility checks and emergency planning.
articles.terminal_impact: Study exclusion zones and emergency arrangements before ammonia trials.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Valencia tenders €7.9m port community system services
articles.summary: Valencia launched a tender exceeding €7.9 million for operation and maintenance of ValenciaportPCS during 2027–2029. The platform provides over 30 services to more than 1,100 organisations, connecting port documentation and logistics processes.
articles.terminal_impact: Assess service continuity and regulatory-update obligations in PCS contracts.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: Bilbao targets full shore-power rollout by end-2027
articles.summary: Bilbao expects all its shore-power facilities to be operational by end-2027. Its authority also led an EU working group reviewing practical barriers such as short calls, equipment failures and technical incompatibilities; the report itself is not a new mandate.
key_points: EU review covers practical implementation barriers
articles.terminal_impact: Test vessel compatibility and exception handling alongside installation plans.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Aarhus tests containership shore power ahead of January launch
articles.summary: Aarhus tested its new containership shore-power facility with Eimskip's Dettifoss, supplying about 6.5 MWh over nearly 10 hours. Daily operation is expected in January 2027; the fully developed facility is designed for four simultaneous vessel connections.
key_points: Four connections planned at full development
articles.terminal_impact: Check berth flexibility and vessel connection testing before commissioning OPS.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Hueneme opens 913 kW solar carport under 20-year PPA
articles.summary: The Port of Hueneme completed a 913 kW solar carport with ForeFront Power over an automobile staging area. A 20-year power purchase agreement avoids upfront port investment, with annual output expected above 1.4 million kWh.
key_points: Over 1.4 million kWh annual output expected
articles.terminal_impact: Evaluate carport solar without sacrificing vehicle staging capacity.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: NorthPort receives four Mitsui hybrid RTGs
articles.summary: NorthPort received four Mitsui E&S hybrid RTGs at Manila. Battery storage paired with smaller diesel engines is expected to cut annual carbon emissions per crane by up to 58.7%, alongside ongoing wharf rehabilitation.
articles.terminal_impact: Compare hybrid fuel savings with the cost of full grid electrification.
articles.criticality_rationale: A concrete deployment or trial result has direct implications for terminal operations.

articles.title: Halifax begins next-generation dynamic clearance trial
articles.summary: Halifax launched an operational trial of OMC's DUKC6 with MarineLabs and port stakeholders. It will combine environmental and operational data for under-keel clearance, with air-draft management and dynamic chart overlays also included.
articles.terminal_impact: Assess whether predictive clearance improves safe vessel windows.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.

articles.title: PortXchange expands emissions forecasting and investment tools
articles.summary: PortXchange plans progressive expansion of EmissionInsider with multimodal monitoring, forecasting, simulations and AI-assisted strategy. Tools will assess options such as OPS and equipment electrification; this multi-site product news is mapped to its Rotterdam base.
key_points: Cargo equipment included in multimodal scope
articles.terminal_impact: Demand transparent assumptions before using simulations to prioritise capital.
articles.criticality_rationale: Early-stage work or a planned service requires further implementation evidence.
